mechanism_class.name: AFO-SA
mechanism_class.description: adaptive final-observable adjoint/source actions with no full or entrywise-equivalent intermediate D21

algebraic_gate.adaptive_kernel_argument: Run the adaptive algorithm on D=0 to freeze its zero-answer query sequence; if q_R+q_L<n-1, choose nonzero zero-diagonal E in the final transcript kernel. D=0 and D=E then generate the same complete adaptive action transcript.
algebraic_gate.conclusion: The pinned nonlinear closure is not a function of any action transcript with q_R+q_L<n-1.

exact_small.hidden_state: E[3,4]=1 and all other entries zero

production_lower_bound.scope: Pinned V29 dense-young factor/source-action circuit using direct dense-thin source actions; information lower bound is algebraic, FLOP bound is class-conditional rather than a universal matrix-multiplication lower bound.

primary_dead_end_constraints: F65: D3/D21 slice-only state is not transport-closed; omitted fully off-diagonal K3 materially contributes to next D21.
F66/F72/F73: source content has high-rank age-dependent cliffs rather than a cheap low-rank universal basis.
F71: D21 is exactly removable only at the final mean-only layer, not at prior nonlinear layers.
F76: capped merged atoms remain too high-rank.
F82: response/slice-series memoryless closure lands on the same slice-state floor.
F88: same-chain higher-rank knobs do not provide a cheap escape.
terminal_reasons: For q_R+q_L<n-1, adaptive D S / D^T T actions are not an exact sufficient statistic for the public nonlinear K3 closure.
For n=1024, exactness requires at least 1023 queried directions, exposing 99.90234375% as many response scalars as a full D21 matrix has entries.
In the requested pinned V29 dense-young source-action circuit, those necessary actions alone cost 0.1951217651 B, above the 0.135 B project cap before old sources or low-order work.
Using a full or entrywise-equivalent adjoint/primal matrix would violate the defining E152 requirement rather than solve it.
successor_rule: Only a deliberately approximate dual compression or a different nonlinear sufficient statistic can be a successor. It requires a new experiment identity and must not be labeled an E152 rescue.
